bias.en: Downtrend · lost the 5 and 10-day, SAR flipped bearish
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 失守 5 日和 10 日均线，SAR 翻空

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 6.4% on Nov 4 to $200.40, trading between $190.60 and $213.96 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($207.2), 10-day ($209.8), 30-day ($246.3) and 100-day ($244.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($222.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 4 ($231.66), and RSI is 40.5.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月4日下跌 6.4%，收于 $200.40，盘中区间 $190.60–213.96，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$207.2）、10 日（$209.8）、30 日（$246.3）和 100 日均线（$244.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$222.2）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月4日翻为看空（$231.66），RSI 为 40.5。

read.en: The close lost the $207.2–213.6 support (5 and 10-day, Nov 3 low $208.0), now resistance; the $190.6 low stopped just above the Oct 23 low ($189). Resistance is $207.2–209.8, then $214.0–222.2 (Nov 4 and Nov 3 highs, 200-day) and $231.7 (SAR). Support is $194.2–197.5, then $189–190.6 and $185.9. A close above $210 would target $214–222; below $189, $186.

s.en: Oct 30 low $194.15; Nov 2 low $194.9; Sep 1 low $197.5
